summary_en: unerry acquired 269,500 shares (7.2% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of 635.48 million yen via ToSTNeT-3 on September 4, 2026, at the closing price of 2,358 yen on September 3, to mitigate market impact from planned sales by major shareholders Mitsubishi Corporation and Dentsu Group.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock via Off-Auction Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On September 3, 2026, unerry's board of directors resolved to acquire treasury stock following notice that major shareholders Mitsubishi Corporation and Dentsu Group intended to sell their holdings. Mitsubishi Corporation planned to sell part of its stake, while Dentsu Group intended to sell its entire position.

The company executed the acquisition via ToSTNeT-3 off-auction trading on September 4, 2026, at 8:45 a.m., at the closing price of 2,358 yen from September 3. The acquisition was for up to 269,500 shares, representing 7.2% of issued shares excluding treasury stock, with a maximum total acquisition price of 635.48 million yen. The buy order was limited to that single trading session only.

The stated rationale was twofold: to avoid adverse market impact from the large planned share sales by these major shareholders, and to enable flexible capital allocation in response to changes in the operating environment. The company confirmed that its capital and business partnerships with both Mitsubishi Corporation and Dentsu Group remained unchanged and that collaboration with these entities would continue.
